abstract: Quality regulation seeks to ensure quality and foster competition by reducing vertical differentiation, but it may also have adverse effects on market structure. We study this trade-off in the context of pharmaceutical bioequivalence, which is the primary quality standard for generic drugs. By exploiting the introduction of bioequivalence in Chile, we find that stronger regulation reduced the number of drugs in the market by 18% and increased average paid prices by 13%. We estimate a model of drug entry, certification, and demand to study how drug quality, aversion to generics, and certification costs shape the equilibrium effects of quality regulation. We find that quality regulation increased demand for generic drugs by resolving asymmetric information and reducing aversion to unbranded generics, which induced the entry of high-quality drugs in place of low-quality drugs. Consumer welfare increased despite higher prices and a lower number of firms. We compare minimum quality standards with alternative designs of quality regulation, including quality disclosure.
title: Quality Regulation and Competition: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Markets
title_zh: 质量监管与竞争：来自药品市场的证据

abstract: We examine whether and to what extent bank organizational specialization affects firm innovation by exploiting the staggered establishment of technology branches across Chinese cities from 2011 to 2024. We find that following the establishment of technology branches, firms produce more patents in previously unexplored technological fields and allocate a larger share of their patent portfolios to these fields. The effect operates primarily through lower financing costs, improved access to tailored credit products, and stronger information-processing and screening capabilities within banks. Our findings suggest that bank organizational specialization facilitates firms’ engagement in explorative innovation.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Bank specialization and explorative innovation: evidence from technology branches in China
title_zh: 银行专业化与探索性创新：来自中国技术分支机构的证据

abstract: We propose a modified unobserved‐component model to investigate the link between macro‐economic uncertainty and business cycle asymmetry of the U.S. economy. The degree of skewness of shocks is assumed to vary with macro‐economic uncertainty. We develop an efficient Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm. Our estimates suggest that high macro‐economic uncertainty tends to be associated with large and negative shocks to the cyclical (but not the trend) component. Quantitatively, a one‐standard‐deviation increase (decrease) in uncertainty results in an expected output change of −0.15 (0.10) percentage points. Low quantiles of the growth distribution, that is, growth‐at‐risk, are particularly susceptible to changes in uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个改进的不可观测成分模型，以考察宏观经济不确定性与美国经济商业周期非对称性之间的联系。假设冲击的偏度随宏观经济不确定性而变化。我们开发了一种高效的贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）算法。我们的估计表明，高宏观经济不确定性往往与对周期性成分（而非趋势成分）的大幅负向冲击相关。在数量上，不确定性每增加（减少）一个标准差，预期产出变化为−0.15（0.10）个百分点。增长分布的低分位数，即风险增长，尤其易受不确定性变化的影响。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Macro‐Economic Uncertainty and Business Cycle Asymmetry
title_zh: 宏观经济不确定性与经济周期不对称性

abstract: While existing studies have extensively examined the role of government employment retention policies in the labour market, relatively little is known about how these policy tools affect employment structure. Using data from Chinese listed firms over 2009–2024 and employing the ratio of employees with a bachelor’s degree or above as a proxy for human capital structure, this paper investigates the effect of the employment stabilization subsidy on corporate human capital structure. We find that the subsidy exerts a negative impact on human capital structure. We use propensity score matching and the difference-in-differences approach to mitigate potential endogeneity concerns. Further heterogeneity analyses reveal that the negative effect is more pronounced among private firms, small firms, and firms with higher pay for high-skill workers. This paper provides new evidence on the impact of government employment retention policies in the labour market and deepens our understanding of how government intervention shapes workforce composition.
china_relevance_reason: 使用中国上市公司2009-2024年数据，研究对象为中国企业人力资本结构，属中国研究。
title: The unintended consequences of the employment stabilization subsidy for corporate human capital structure
title_zh: 就业稳定补贴对企业人力资本结构的意外后果

abstract: In this paper, we study foreign ownership as a vehicle for transferring gender norms across international borders. Using detailed matched employer‐employee data from Sweden, we analyze how the within‐firm gender pay gap is affected by the degree of gender inequality in the home country of foreign investors. The results suggest that home‐country gender norms matter: The pay gap between men and women in foreign‐owned subsidiaries tends to decrease with the degree of gender equality in the investors' home market. Specifically, we find that acquisitions from countries with higher levels of gender equality tend to reduce the gender pay gap, whereas acquisitions from countries with lower levels of gender equality have no significant impact. We identify the effect from within‐match variation in incomes and rely on a dynamic difference‐in‐differences model and a high‐dimensional fixed effects model.
abstract_zh: 本文研究外资所有权作为跨国界转移性别规范的载体。我们使用瑞典详细的雇主—雇员匹配数据，分析外资来源国的性别不平等程度如何影响企业内部性别薪酬差距。结果表明，来源国性别规范具有重要影响：外资子公司中男女薪酬差距往往随着投资者母国市场性别平等程度的提高而缩小。具体而言，我们发现，来自性别平等水平较高国家的收购往往会缩小性别薪酬差距，而来自性别平等水平较低国家的收购则没有显著影响。我们通过匹配内部收入变化来识别这一效应，并依赖动态双重差分模型和高维固定效应模型。
title: Foreign ownership and transferring of gender norms
title_zh: 外国所有权与性别规范的转移

abstract: How environmental and financial policies interact to foster firms’ participation in emissions abatement is a critical question for green transition. This study constructs a two-sector environmental dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model that incorporates heterogeneous firms. Based on this framework, we systematically examine the standalone and synergistic effects of three environmental policies—environmental tax, subsidy for clean equipment and capital subsidy—as well as the green credit policy. Our analysis yields three key insights. First, the environmental tax imposed on brown projects can promote green transition but tends to deteriorate the macroeconomy, and the tax’s spillover effects on green projects further exacerbate this outcome. Second, introducing green credit into environmental policies’ implementation can enhance their effectiveness in terms of output performance and emissions reduction by expanding the intensive margin of green projects. Third, coordinated environmental policies and green credit improve social welfare, demonstrating a positive correlation between green credit support intensity and welfare gains. These results emphasize the importance of coordinated and balanced green policy frameworks.
abstract_zh: 环境政策与金融政策如何相互作用以促进企业参与减排，是绿色转型中的一个关键问题。本研究构建了一个包含异质性企业的两部门环境动态随机一般均衡模型。基于该框架，我们系统考察了三种环境政策——环境税、清洁设备补贴和资本补贴——以及绿色信贷政策的独立效应与协同效应。我们的分析得出三个关键洞见。第一，对棕色项目征收环境税能够促进绿色转型，但往往会恶化宏观经济，而环境税对绿色项目的溢出效应进一步加剧了这一结果。第二，在环境政策实施中引入绿色信贷，能够通过扩大绿色项目的集约边际，提升其在产出表现和减排方面的有效性。第三，环境政策与绿色信贷的协调配合改善了社会福利，表明绿色信贷支持强度与福利收益之间存在正相关关系。这些结果凸显了协调且平衡的绿色政策框架的重要性。
title: Promoting the Green Transition through Green Credit and Environmental Policy Coordination: A DSGE Analysis
title_zh: 通过绿色信贷与环境政策协调促进绿色转型：一个DSGE分析

abstract: We study how judicial independence affects the stability of corporate supply chains, exploiting the staggered, city-level rollout of China’s vertical management reform of local courts in a difference-in-differences design. The reform lowers the churn of firms’ top suppliers and customers and lengthens their longest-standing relationships. This average masks a reallocation margin: after the reform, firms with greater hold-up exposure replace partners more often than other firms, consistent with enforcement-enabled reallocation. Stabilization is stronger where partner relationships are less publicly visible and among firms with more transparent accounting or greater analyst coverage, and duration gains are larger for financially constrained firms. The reform also raises total factor productivity and extends the geographic reach of supply chains. Impartial enforcement thus shapes both the durability of firm-to-firm relationships and the reallocation of partners.
abstract_zh: 我们研究司法独立如何影响企业供应链的稳定性，利用中国地方法院垂直管理改革在市级层面交错推行的准自然实验，采用双重差分设计进行识别。该改革降低了企业前五大供应商与客户的更替率，并延长了其维持最久的合作关系。这一平均效应掩盖了一个再配置边际：改革后，套牢风险更高的企业比其他企业更频繁地更换合作伙伴，这与执法能力提升所促成的再配置相一致。在合作伙伴关系公开可见度较低的情形下，以及在会计信息更透明或分析师覆盖更多的企业中，稳定化效应更强；而对于融资受限的企业，关系持续时间的提升更大。该改革还提高了全要素生产率，并拓展了供应链的地理覆盖范围。因此，公正执法既塑造了企业间关系的持久性，也影响了合作伙伴的再配置。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Courts and chains: The real effects of judicial independence on supply chain stability
title_zh: 法院与链条：司法独立对供应链稳定性的实际影响

abstract: We introduce a sustainability constraint into a two-sector production economy with green and brown capital, requiring the welfare measure to be non-decreasing over time. The constraint binds only when the brown capital share is high. When it binds, the planner reduces current consumption and reallocates resources toward investment, especially green investment. The constraint also lowers the risk-free rate and raises the risk premium and Tobin’s q .
abstract_zh: 我们在一个包含绿色资本和棕色资本的两部门生产经济中引入可持续性约束，要求福利指标随时间非递减。该约束仅在棕色资本份额较高时才会起作用。当其起作用时，规划者会减少当前消费，并将资源重新配置到投资，尤其是绿色投资。该约束还会降低无风险利率，并提高风险溢价和托宾q。
title: Sustainability for a greener economy
title_zh: 绿色经济的可持续性

abstract: We examine what is widely considered to be one of the strongest channels of monetary policy transmission into household spending—the effect of changes in mortgage repayments when mortgage rates are linked to the short-term policy rate. Using bank transactions data from Australia, we analyze a cumulative 425 basis point increase in the central bank policy rate, which caused mortgage repayments for homeowners with adjustable-rate mortgages to increase by $13,800 over the tightening cycle. We find little change in the spending of adjustable-rate mortgagors relative to fixed-rate mortgagors. This is because adjustable-rate mortgagors used large excess repayment buffers they had accumulated to smooth consumption. Our findings demonstrate that high household liquidity, such as from a large fiscal stimulus, substantially weakens the effects of monetary tightening, even when there is a strong direct link between policy rates and household budgets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了被广泛认为是货币政策向家庭支出传导的最强渠道之一——当抵押贷款利率与短期政策利率挂钩时，抵押贷款还款变化的影响。利用澳大利亚的银行交易数据，我们分析了央行政策利率累计上调425个基点的情况，这导致浮动利率抵押贷款房主的抵押贷款还款在紧缩周期内增加了13,800美元。我们发现，相对于固定利率抵押贷款者，浮动利率抵押贷款者的支出几乎没有变化。这是因为浮动利率抵押贷款者利用他们积累的巨额超额还款缓冲来平滑消费。我们的研究结果表明，高家庭流动性，例如来自大规模财政刺激的流动性，会大幅削弱货币紧缩的效果，即使政策利率与家庭预算之间存在很强的直接联系。
title: Household liquidity and the adjustable-rate mortgage cash-flow channel of monetary policy
title_zh: 家庭流动性与货币政策的可调利率抵押贷款现金流渠道

abstract: How does the expansion of renewable energy affect electricity price volatility? Despite a growing body of empirical work, the evidence remains mixed, with divergent effects reported across markets and technologies. We develop a theoretical framework that helps reconcile this mixed evidence by decomposing the volatility effect into two channels: the curvature effect, through which renewables shift the equilibrium along the merit-order curve, and the dispersion effect, through which renewables alter the variability of residual demand. We empirically assess this framework using hourly real-time data from the Shandong and Shanxi electricity spot markets in China. We document divergent intraday effects between wind and solar, opposing wind effects across the two provinces, and a sign reversal in the solar effect at the daily scale. These seemingly contradictory patterns can be coherently interpreted as the interplay of the curvature and dispersion channels, demonstrating that the framework provides a unified account for understanding the divergent volatility effects of renewables across technologies, markets, and frequencies.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源的扩张如何影响电价波动性？尽管实证研究日益增多，但证据仍不一致，不同市场和技术之间报告了各异的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，通过将波动性效应分解为两个渠道来帮助调和这些混杂证据：曲率效应，即可再生能源沿优序曲线移动均衡；以及离散效应，即可再生能源改变剩余需求的可变性。我们使用中国山东和山西电力现货市场的小时实时数据对该框架进行实证评估。我们记录了风能与太阳能的日内效应差异、两省之间相反的风能效应，以及太阳能效应在日尺度上的符号反转。这些看似矛盾的模式可以被一致地解释为曲率渠道与离散渠道的相互作用，表明该框架为理解可再生能源在不同技术、市场和频率上各异的波动性效应提供了一个统一的解释。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Along and beyond the curve: Disentangling the volatility effects of renewable energy
title_zh: 沿曲线及其之外：解析可再生能源的波动性效应

abstract: The 2022 energy price shock, triggered by geopolitical disruptions, prompted governments to implement widespread policy interventions to support firms and accelerate the energy transition. Using nationally representative firm surveys from the United States and Germany, this paper examines how firms adjusted to the shock and their reported responses to fiscal incentives. We document that firms were generally resilient, relying on a combination of price pass-through, margin adjustment, and energy-saving investments. Responses differed across countries: firms in Germany – facing a larger and more persistent shock – were more likely to invest in energy efficiency and reduce energy consumption, while firms in the United States primarily absorbed costs through lower profits. Evidence from input-output simulations suggests that, absent policy intervention, energy-intensive sectors would have faced substantially larger price pressures. We also find that firms with pre-existing plans to reduce greenhouse gas emissions were more likely to report intending to utilize fiscal incentive programs, suggesting that policy targeting and credibility may play an important role in supporting the green transition. Overall, our findings provide descriptive evidence on firms’ responses to energy price shocks and announced policy measures, offering insights for the design of targeted and predictable energy and climate policies in an increasingly fragmented geopolitical environment.
abstract_zh: 2022年由地缘政治扰动引发的能源价格冲击，促使各国政府实施广泛的政策干预，以支持企业并加速能源转型。本文利用美国和德国具有全国代表性的企业调查，考察企业如何调整以适应这一冲击，以及它们对财政激励措施所报告的响应。我们发现，企业总体上具有韧性，依靠价格转嫁、利润调整和节能投资的组合来应对。各国之间的响应存在差异：德国企业——面临更大且更持久的冲击——更可能投资于能源效率并减少能源消耗，而美国企业则主要通过降低利润来吸收成本。来自投入产出模拟的证据表明，若没有政策干预，能源密集型部门将面临大得多的价格压力。我们还发现，已有减少温室气体排放计划的企业更可能报告打算利用财政激励项目，这表明政策 targeting 和可信度可能在支持绿色转型中发挥重要作用。总体而言，我们的发现提供了关于企业对能源价格冲击和已宣布政策措施的响应的描述性证据，为在日益碎片化的地缘政治环境中设计有针对性和可预测的能源与气候政策提供了见解。
title: Energy shocks, firm resilience, and policy responses: Evidence from the 2022 crisis*
title_zh: 能源冲击、企业韧性与政策应对：来自2022年危机的证据*

abstract: Investing in children’s human capital reduces business investments for U.S. entrepreneurial households. Using financial account data of 90,000 small businesses linked to their owners and a regression discontinuity design that compares the business performance of households with college-aged dependents (18–22) to those with near-college-aged dependents (14–17), I show that business revenues and expenses decline sharply when owners’ children reach age 18. Despite the declines, profitability and productivity remain largely unaffected, suggesting a general downsizing rather than a loss in efficiency. Heterogeneity analysis shows that downsizing is concentrated among highly indebted owner households and businesses with volatile cash flows. For each dollar increase in household spending associated with a child turning 18, business expenses decline by $2.26. These findings are consistent with entrepreneurial parents reallocating capital from business investments toward their children’s human capital, as both compete for the same pool of internal family financial resources. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04789 .
abstract_zh: 投资子女的人力资本会减少美国创业型家庭的企业投资。本文利用约9万家小企业的金融账户数据，并将其与其所有者相关联，采用断点回归设计，比较有大学适龄受抚养子女（18—22岁）的家庭与有接近大学适龄受抚养子女（14—17岁）的家庭的企业绩效，结果表明，当所有者的子女年满18岁时，企业收入和支出均大幅下降。尽管出现下降，盈利能力和生产率基本未受影响，这表明企业总体收缩，而非效率损失。异质性分析显示，收缩主要集中在高负债的所有者家庭以及现金流波动较大的企业。子女年满18岁所带来的家庭支出每增加1美元，企业支出便减少2.26美元。这些发现与创业型父母将资本从企业投资重新配置到子女的人力资本相一致，因为二者竞争同一家庭内部金融资源池。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融学）接收。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04789获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Trading Off Business and Family Investments: Evidence from U.S. Entrepreneurial Households
title_zh: 权衡商业与家庭投资：来自美国创业家庭的证据

abstract: Stablecoins are the current go-to digital money to settle transactions on the blockchain. We explore the implications of introducing competing tokenized public digital monies (i.e., tokenized central bank digital currencies (CBDCs)). When they pay a moderate interest rate and guarantee users’ anonymity, tokenized CBDCs crowd out stablecoins. However, when they pay a high interest rate and have low anonymity features, stablecoin issuers could use tokenized CBDCs as collateral, promoting the creation of stablecoins. We identify conditions under which introducing a CBDC to compete with stablecoins in the crypto sector would be socially optimal. This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: Support from Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) [Grant 100018 219835].
abstract_zh: 稳定币是目前在区块链上结算交易的首选数字货币。我们探讨引入与之竞争的代币化公共数字货币（即代币化央行数字货币（CBDC））所产生的影响。当代币化CBDC支付适度利率并保障用户匿名性时，它会挤出稳定币。然而，当代币化CBDC支付高利率且匿名性特征较低时，稳定币发行方可将代币化CBDC用作抵押品，从而促进稳定币的创造。我们识别出在何种条件下，在加密领域引入CBDC与稳定币竞争具有社会最优性。本文由Will Cong接受，发表于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：瑞士国家科学基金会（SNSF）的支持[资助号100018 219835]。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Money Creation for Crypto Space: Stablecoins or Central Bank Digital Currencies?
title_zh: 加密货币领域的货币创造：稳定币还是央行数字货币？

abstract: Declining fertility and rising longevity are accelerating population aging worldwide. We study their effects on interest rates using a quantitative life-cycle model that explicitly accounts for the long lag between birth and labor-market entry, and features Barro-Becker parental preference, endogenous human capital accumulation, and a public pension system. Reducing fertility raises the interest rate during a sustained transition, as agents increase consumption in anticipation of future labor shortages and wage growth, before converging to a lower steady state. Increasing longevity instead monotonically reduces the interest rate by raising precautionary savings. These divergent dynamics are robust to variations in the pension system, human capital inputs, and child-related allocations. A historical decomposition further shows that fertility shocks have been the dominant demographic driver of U.S. interest rate fluctuations since 1960. These findings challenge the view that aging uniformly lowers interest rates and highlight the distinct implications of fertility- and longevity-driven aging.
abstract_zh: 生育率下降与寿命延长正在加速全球人口老龄化。本文运用一个量化生命周期模型研究二者对利率的影响，该模型明确考虑了出生与进入劳动力市场之间的长滞后，并具有巴罗-贝克尔父母偏好、内生人力资本积累和公共养老金制度等特征。在持续转型期间，生育率下降会推高利率，因为个体预期未来劳动力短缺和工资增长而增加消费，随后收敛至较低的稳态。相反，寿命延长通过提高预防性储蓄而单调降低利率。这些分化动态在养老金制度、人力资本投入和与子女相关的资源配置发生变化时依然稳健。历史分解进一步表明，自1960年以来，生育冲击一直是美国利率波动的主要人口驱动因素。这些发现挑战了老龄化会一致降低利率的观点，并凸显了生育率驱动型老龄化与寿命驱动型老龄化的不同含义。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Dynamic Effects of Population Aging on Natural Interest Rates
title_zh: 人口老龄化对自然利率的动态效应

abstract: This paper presents estimates of the causal effect of a multifaceted support program for low-income high school students on crime. The program, called Pathways to Education, bundles a number of supports including regular coaching, tutoring, group activities, free public transportation tickets and bursaries for postsecondary education. Our empirical strategy uses administrative data on high school enrollment linked to administrative court records and a difference-in-differences methodology that compares the evolution of crime outcomes of students living in the public housing communities where Pathways operates to similar public housing students who are ineligible for the program. We find that eligibility for Pathways reduces the likelihood of being charged with a crime at its Regent Park location by 6 percentage points (33 percent of the pre-treatment mean) and has no statistically significant effect at its Rexdale and Lawrence Heights locations. Our results suggest that the reductions in criminal activity are driven by the reduction of property crimes.
title: The impact of comprehensive student support on crime: Evidence from the pathways to education program
title_zh: 综合学生支持对犯罪的影响：来自教育路径计划的证据

abstract: This study investigates how international anti-tax avoidance measures promote domestic firms' tax compliance by improving tax fairness, using the implementation of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) project in China as a quasi-natural experiment. The BEPS project curtails multinationals' tax avoidance and elevates their tax burden, improving overall tax fairness. The expanded tax base also incentivizes tax authorities to mitigate enforcement inconsistencies and establish a fairer tax administration environment. In response to heightened tax fairness, domestic firms exhibit increased tax compliance. Following the BEPS project implementation, a one standard deviation increase in multinationals' market share is associated with a 0.49 percentage point (8.75%) decrease in domestic firms' book-tax differences. This study identifies the spillover effects of multinationals' tax avoidance on domestic firms' tax compliance and demonstrates a previously unexplored mechanism whereby international anti-tax avoidance measures influence government revenue.
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: International anti-tax avoidance, tax fairness and domestic tax compliance
title_zh: 国际反避税、税收公平与国内税收遵从

abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in social sciences, but their training data can introduce lookahead bias and training leakage. A good chronologically consistent language model requires efficient use of training data to maintain accuracy despite time-restricted data. Here, we overcome this challenge by training a suite of chronologically consistent large language models, ChronoBERT and ChronoGPT, which incorporate only the text data that would have been available at each point in time. Despite this strict temporal constraint, our models achieve strong performance on natural language processing benchmarks, outperforming or matching widely used models (e.g., BERT), and remain competitive with larger open-weight models. Lookahead bias is model and application-specific because even if a chronologically consistent language model has poorer language comprehension, a regression or prediction model applied on top of the language model can compensate. In an asset pricing application predicting next-day stock returns from financial news embeddings, we find that ChronoBERT and ChronoGPT’s real-time outputs achieve Sharpe ratios comparable to a much larger and potentially biased Llama model. Our results demonstrate a scalable, practical framework to mitigate training leakage, ensuring more credible backtests and predictions across finance and other social science domains.
title: Chronologically consistent large language models
title_zh: 时间顺序一致的大型语言模型

abstract: This paper studies how human capital shapes the economic geography of development. We propose a model in which human capital acquisition costs vary across space, and regions with higher human capital invest more in human-capital-augmenting technology. Locations are interconnected through costly migration and trade. Using data on local income and schooling, we quantify the model at a 1 ∘ × 1 ∘ resolution globally. Over two centuries, the model mostly predicts persistence in the spatial distribution of development. Proportionally lowering education costs in sub-Saharan Africa raises local outcomes but lowers global welfare, while the same policy in Latin America improves global welfare. An alternative policy that equalizes educational costs across sub-Saharan Africa generates worse outcomes, as population shifts within the region toward less productive areas. These results are driven by the estimated negative correlation between education costs and local fundamentals, as well as spatial inefficiencies due to externalities.
title: Human capital accumulation across space
title_zh: 人力资本的空间积累

abstract: I argue that household heterogeneity plays a key role in the transmission of aggregate shocks in emerging market economies. Using Mexico’s 1995 crisis as a case study, I document that whether a household works in the tradable or non-tradable sector is a crucial determinant of income and consumption losses: households tied to the non-tradable sector suffered substantially larger losses, regardless of other characteristics. To account for this fact, I build a New Keynesian small open economy model featuring two dimensions of household heterogeneity: uninsurable sector-specific income and limited participation in financial markets. Both dimensions shape how shocks propagate, typically amplifying their effects in the non-tradable sector while dampening them in the tradable sector. On the policy side, the welfare cost associated with lack of exchange rate flexibility is higher when households are heterogeneous, though sectoral preferences over such flexibility diverge when policy is restricted to simple interest rate rules.
title: Emerging markets, household heterogeneity, and exchange rate policy
title_zh: 新兴市场、家庭异质性与汇率政策

abstract: Recent studies show that momentum in factor premia, rather than in individual asset returns, drives the momentum anomaly in equity markets. We examine whether factor momentum extends to corporate bonds, using a novel manually cleaned dataset of 155 corporate bond factors spanning 1985 to 2023. We document a factor momentum effect although it is economically modest and sample dependent, with monthly alphas ranging from 10 to 28 basis points. Cross-sectional strategies built on bond-level and within-firm factors are the most robust, remaining significant even after accounting for conservative transaction costs. Time series strategies, by contrast, do not survive trading frictions. Bond-level and within-firm factor momentum are not subsumed by bond or equity price momentum, whereas the reverse holds only for its equity variant. The results of this study (i) extend the factor momentum literature to a market that has so far received little attention, (ii) provide evidence that return continuation is not pervasive across risk factors, and (iii) document that price and factor momentum, although related, originate from different sources of return variation.
title: Corporate bond factor momentum
title_zh: 公司债券因子动量

abstract: By using a comprehensive dataset on US Treasury securities, we study the accuracy of first- and second-order approximations for bond returns. Using the duration alone leads to a systematic underestimation of returns, especially for long-term instruments, but a daily duration-convexity approximation is accurate at all maturities. For both approximations, including the “passage of time”, which is the contribution of discounting to the bond return, is essential, else returns are severely underestimated, especially if interest rates are high. A monthly approximation still gives acceptable results, but an annual one is less accurate, even if all terms are included.
title: How accurate is the Taylor approximation of bond returns?
title_zh: 债券回报的泰勒近似有多准确？

abstract: Researchers increasingly rely on agentic artificial intelligence to assist with research. I examine the sampling and specification choices AI agents make and compare them to those of human experts. Fixing the research question and raw data across 156 agent runs, AIs tend to cluster on certain options. Compared to 145 human expert analyses of the same question and data, estimation outcomes are broadly similar. AI achieves this, however, via systematically different choices. Agentic AI thus remains an imperfect substitute for human researchers for the models tested.
title: Research choices of agentic artificial intelligence
title_zh: 代理型人工智能的研究选择

abstract: Using 252,993 responses from the Bank of England Inflation Attitudes Survey, this paper examines the relationship between central-bank confidence, the term structure of inflation expectations, and forecast accuracy. Dissatisfied households show stronger pass-through from perceived inflation to medium- and long-term expectations. Among respondents in the same wave and current-inflation and one-year-expectation categories, their five-year expectations remain 0.37 percentage points higher. A Shapley decomposition leaves 40% of the five-year gap unexplained by those beliefs. Dissatisfied households make larger five-year forecast errors under midpoint and interval-consistent coding. The evidence is consistent with weaker long-term anchoring rather than more accurate pessimism.
title: Confidence at the long end: Central-bank satisfaction and household inflation expectations
title_zh: 长端信心：央行满意度与家庭通胀预期

abstract: The New Keynesian argument is that flexible exchange rate regimes cannot stabilize cyclical developments at the ZLB, as the real exchange rate appreciates in response to adverse demand shocks. We estimate the effects of a negative domestic demand shock on the real exchange rate for the euro area vis-à-vis the United States, Canada, and Japan by state-dependent sign-restricted local projection methods. We find a real depreciation when interest rates are not at the ZLB, but also when they are. The exchange rate can accommodate considerable variations in output, confirming its shock-absorbing capacity away and during ZLB episodes. The stabilizing role of the exchange rate is accompanied by a significant expansion of the ECB’s balance sheet at the ZLB, while it remained unaffected in the non-ZLB period.
title: On the empirical relevance of the exchange rate as a shock absorber at the zero lower bound
title_zh: 论汇率在零利率下限作为冲击吸收器的实证相关性

abstract: While tax distortion on capital can significantly impact resource allocation in developing economies, credible causal evidence remains scarce. This study provides novel evidence by examining China’s 2009 value-added tax (VAT) reform, which allowed specific firms to deduct taxes on capital inputs, thereby mitigating distortions in the taxation of capital. Using firm-level tax return data from 2006 to 2015, we demonstrate that the reform enhanced the allocative efficiency of capital by reducing the dispersion in marginal revenue product of capital (MRPK) within industries. Our empirical results show that firms with high ex-ante MRPK experienced a 10.5% increase in physical capital and a 6.0% decrease in MRPK post-reform, relative to low-MRPK firms within the same industry. The effects were particularly pronounced among smaller firms and those with restricted access to debt, consistent with the reform alleviating binding financial constraints. At the supply-side margin, the reform’s misallocation-reducing effect was amplified in localities with greater access to banking services, consistent with local credit availability facilitating the translation of latent capital demand into actual investment. Moreover, the reform improved labor allocation through input complementarity and the alleviation of financial constraints. Our calibration exercise suggests that the reform increased the aggregate productivity of treated firms by 3.1–4.0%, with nonlinear approximations that account for cumulative dynamics yielding estimates of up to 7.8%. These findings highlight the importance of addressing tax distortions for efficient resource allocation in developing economies.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Tax distortion on capital and resource misallocation: evidence from China’s VAT reform
title_zh: 资本税负扭曲与资源错配：来自中国增值税改革的证据

abstract: We examine how political shifts affect household economic sentiment and spending in identity-polarized settings. Using panel data on over 178,000 Indian households, we find that sentiment about personal finances—and, to a lesser extent, the national economy—predicts expenditure, even after accounting for income changes. Using close state elections, we show that Muslims become markedly more pessimistic than Hindus about national economic conditions following victories by the Hindu-nationalist party, but exhibit relatively smaller differences in personal financial sentiment and no detectable divergence in overall expenditure. We find some evidence, however, of Hindu-Muslim divergence in potentially deferrable choices—healthcare, luxury spending, and asset purchases—particularly among urban, educated, and white-collar households. A Bayesian learning framework explains the insulation of consumption from politically induced sentiment shocks through the limited and heterogeneous transmission of macro-beliefs to individual behavior in high-volatility environments.
title: Identity politics, partisan sentiment and household spending
title_zh: 身份政治、党派情绪与家庭支出

abstract: Household surveys often replace unavailable transaction prices with unit values. This article examines linear approximate Almost Ideal Demand System (LA/AIDS) applications in which raw or incompletely standardized household unit values enter a contemporaneous current-share Stone index. Building on the established non-commensurability of that index, it develops a household-level representation of the measurement-unit channel, isolates its transmission through the real-expenditure deflator, and quantifies the resulting sensitivity. An exact-AIDS Monte Carlo design with 500 replications per scenario shows that fixed commodity-specific unit scales generate elasticity differences through the Stone deflator; these grow with scale magnitude or dispersion and vanish in a homothetic null check. Corrected Stone and Törnqvist leave numerically negligible fixed-scale differences, with maximum mean absolute differences below 7×10−8. The Malawi application compares paired LA/AIDS specifications within a common sample while holding market-price regressors fixed. Standardized unit values are substantially more comparable with separately collected kilogram-based market-survey prices. The mean absolute centred raw–standardized index difference is 0.628 under current-share Stone, versus 0.493, 0.402, and 0.339 under corrected Stone, Törnqvist, and base-share indices; the mean absolute difference in conditional expenditure elasticities is 0.307. The evidence quantifies specification sensitivity for conditional purchased-food responses in this LA/AIDS implementation.
title: Household unit values, measurement units, and the current-share Stone index in LA/AIDS estimation
title_zh: LA/AIDS估计中的家庭单位价值、计量单位与当期份额Stone指数

abstract: This paper analyses the state-dependent effects of geopolitical risks on gold prices (i.e. the safe-haven role of gold), conditional on financial conditions. Geopolitical risks are often associated with tighter financial conditions. However, recent data reveal a decoupling be tween such shocks and more restrictive financial conditions, raising the question of how gold returns are affected by geopolitical shocks, conditional on the macro-financial environment. Using monthly data from 1990 to 2026, we find that increases in geopolitical risks– both geopolitical threats and realised events– increase gold returns, with stronger effects ob served during periods of loose financial conditions. We decompose this relationship into two mechanisms: (i) the credit and liquidity risk channel and (ii) the opportunity cost channel. Our findings indicate that the relationship operates most clearly through the first channel, suggesting that the key factor is investors’ capacity to rebalance, while the evidence for the second channel is less conclusive. Finally, we also find that the largest impact occurs when periods of loose financial conditions are compounded with periods of geopolitical escala tions, as seen in 2024–26. These insights highlight the relevance of understanding gold as a safe-haven asset amid complex macro-financial conditions.
title: Chasing El Dorado: gold under shifting geopolitical and financial conditions
title_zh: 追逐黄金国：地缘政治与金融格局变迁下的黄金

abstract: La question de savoir si l’enseignement des compétences cognitives reste pertinent à l’ère de l’IA est cruciale tant pour le monde de l’éducation que pour les entreprises. Cet article rend compte d’une expérience menée auprès d’environ 1 000 étudiants de premier cycle en Italie, qui ont reçu soit (1) une formation au raisonnement causal, (2) un accès à ChatGPT, (3) les deux, soit (4) aucun des deux. Si les étudiants ayant utilisé ChatGPT ont obtenu de meilleurs résultats lors d’un devoir consistant à rédiger une recommandation de 180 mots sur un problème concret, seuls ceux ayant suivi la formation au raisonnement causal ont proposé des idées originales. Ces résultats soulignent les avantages de combiner une formation à la réflexion par principes fondamentaux avec l’utilisation de grands modèles linguistiques.
title: Apprendre aux débutants à réfléchir à l’ère des grands modèles linguistiques
title_zh: 在大语言模型时代教初学者思考

abstract: Forecasts indicate that the UK will miss its Clean Power 2030 targets. This study evaluates the techno-economic barriers and limitations in terms of infrastructure, demand, and resources of Clean Power (2030) Action Plan policies by conducting thorough discussions with power sector experts. Identified limitations in the literature together with interview findings allow us to suggest actionable policies. Even though there have been previous works on the techno-economic barriers pertaining to achieving Clean Power by 2030, this paper presents a fresh systematic approach, by applying a meta-theoretical framework to analyse holistically the techno-economic barriers in this energy transition. While previous works on this topic focus mostly on near-term market intelligence, and policy- or investor-oriented insights, the novelty of this work provides operational insights from industry experts. Results reveal a gap between ambitious policy objectives and ground-level implementation concerns; such as unrealistic milestones, and conflicting local authorities and government timelines. This paper outlines the following policies to facilitate UK's transition to a zero-carbon power system: (1) reform the planning and permitting system with new amendments, (2) assess the NESO project applications in batches, (3) mandate community benefits sharing, (4) run an independent board to facilitate effective communication amongst various stakeholders, (5) undertake market integration of demand-side response and flexibility providers, (6) offer technology-specific incentives, and (7) address supply chain contingency agreements.
title: Challenges in the decarbonization of the UK electrical power system by 2030: A techno-economic analysis of current and alternative policies
title_zh: 2030年英国电力系统脱碳的挑战：对当前及替代政策的技术经济分析

abstract: Although debt maturity is central to firms’ operations, how informal institutions such as local gambling preferences shape it remains unclear. Using a sample of A-share listed firms from 2008 to 2023, this paper explores whether and how local gambling preferences shape corporate debt maturity in China. Results show that stronger local gambling preferences are significantly associated with shorter corporate debt maturity, suggesting that firms in such regions tend to receive debt financing with shorter maturities. This result remains robust across a series of sensitivity and endogeneity tests, including instrumental variable approaches, omitted variables test, lagged term of gambling preferences, entropy matching, and other robustness checks. In addition, this effect can be attributed to a deteriorated information environment, worse corporate governance, and greater speculative investment. Consistent with these findings, this effect is more pronounced in firms with smaller assets, more financing constraints and those located in regions with lower financial development. Our study contributes to the broader literature on debt maturity by highlighting how informal institutions and local cultural norms can shape corporate financing behaviour.

title: Birds of a feather? Local gambling preferences and corporate debt maturity in China
title_zh: 物以类聚？中国地方赌博偏好与企业债务期限

abstract: Curbing carbon emissions to meet the targets set in the Paris Agreement requires the deployment of low‐carbon technologies (LCTs) at a global scale. This paper assesses the role of climate and trade policies in fostering LCT diffusion through trade. Leveraging a comprehensive database of climate policies and a new database identifying trade in LCTs and the tariffs applied to these goods, this paper shows that the introduction of new climate policies has a positive and significant impact on LCT imports. Zooming into specific climate policies, the paper finds that, except for non‐binding ones, all climate policies stimulate LCT imports. The paper also highlights the role of trade policies as an engine of LCT diffusion—reductions in tariffs applied to LCT goods have a sizable impact on LCT imports. On the flip side, results suggest that more protectionist measures would impede the spread of LCTs.
title: Trade in Low‐Carbon Technologies: The Role of Climate and Trade Policies
title_zh: 低碳技术贸易：气候与贸易政策的作用

abstract: We study branch openings and closures in U.S. banking. Both are concentrated where depositors are rate-sensitive and place less value on physical access, patterns driven by financially sophisticated households with greater digital adoption. The effects are strongest for large banks, with lending playing a lesser role. Incumbents retain branches where depositors are less sensitive and more reliant on proximity; entrants avoid such markets because sticky customers are difficult to attract. The Pandemic accelerated closures while allowing banks to retain deposits through online channels. Overall, depositor sophistication — through rate sensitivity and reduced branch reliance — drives modern branch restructuring.
title: The decline of branch banking
title_zh: 分行银行业的衰落

abstract: We introduce a unified double selection framework accommodating group-specific additive and multiplicative shifters of an unobserved common time trend (CTT). Under double selection, the CTT does not manifest as a parallel trend; the resulting non-constant selection bias is a linear combination nesting standard difference-in-differences (DiD) in levels and logs. Opposing shifters can yield patterns structurally impossible under standard DiDs, such as a ranking reversal of the groups over time. We establish that in the presence of double selection bias treatment effects are non-parametrically identified by the change of the ratio of within-group outcome changes over time. The double selection structure induces a stable linear relationship in the outcome-on-outcome space, grounding a simple two-step estimator operating in levels. Revisiting Card (1992), double selection uncovers valid counterfactuals where standard DiD fails.
title: Double Selection in Causal Inference
title_zh: 因果推断中的双重选择

abstract: An uninformed sender publicly commits to an informative experiment about an uncertain state, privately observes its outcome, and sends a cheap talk message to a receiver. We provide an algorithm valid for arbitrary state-dependent preferences that will determine the sender’s optimal experiment and his equilibrium payoff under a binary state space. We provide conditions for informative information transmission to occur or to fail. These conditions depend more on marginal incentives—how payoffs vary with the state—than on the alignment of the sender’s and the receiver’s rankings over actions within a state. The algorithm can be easily modified to study the canonical cheap talk game with a perfectly informed sender.
title: Information design in cheap talk
title_zh: 廉价谈话中的信息设计

abstract: This paper examines the impact of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) on firms’ markups using a difference-in-differences model and data on A-share listed companies in China from 2011 to 2024. Results indicate that the BRI significantly increases firms’ markups, and this finding remains robust across a series of sensitivity tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that the BRI enhances markups by reducing operating costs and alleviating financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that the effect is more pronounced among non-emerging industries, high factor-intensive firms, state-owned enterprises, small-scale firms, and firms in provinces along the Maritime Silk Road. This paper shows a new perspective in understanding the microeconomic effects of the BRI from the perspective of firms’ markups, and also provides new ideas for promoting the implementation of the BRI.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The Belt and Road Initiative and firms’ markups: evidence from China
title_zh: 一带一路”倡议与企业加成率：来自中国的证据

abstract: Central banks increasingly disclose their private information regarding the economy’s current and future state (CBET). Consistent with CBET shifting investors’ collection and pricing of aggregate-level (where managers do not have an information advantage) toward firm-level (where managers do have an information advantage) information, we find that CBET reduces managers’ learning from stock price. The results are (1) pronounced when firms do not provide guidance and when noise trading in firms’ stock is low, and (2) robust to using the 2013–2014 amendments to the Bank of England’s Inflation Report as an exogenous shock. Additional evidence suggests that CBET lowers investment efficiency. (JEL E22, E52, M41)
title: Central Bank Economic Transparency and Managerial Learning
title_zh: 央行经济透明度与管理层学习

abstract: Using résumé data on over 20 million U.S. workers, we find that the flow of employees between a pair of firms sharply drops by about 20% during periods in which the firms share a board director. This relationship is stronger in settings where firms have greater potential gains from limiting worker mobility and is most pronounced for higher-skilled employees. Moreover, we find more connected firms have lower rates of internal promotion and no improvements in employee satisfaction. The evidence is consistent with shared directors serving as a mechanism for labor market coordination. (JEL G34, G38, J42, J62, J08, K21, K31, M50)
title: Directing the Labor Market: Shared Directors and Employee Flows
title_zh: 引导劳动力市场：共享董事与员工流动

abstract: We study a Bayesian persuasion game in which a decision maker (DM) incurs psychological costs from belief-disconfirming information and chooses whether to engage with the sender’s experiment. We model preference-based confirmation bias as psychological discomfort from exposure to signals that conflict with the DM’s prior beliefs. Whenever persuasion is feasible, the sender must commit to a strictly more informative experiment than in the Kamenica–Gentzkow (2011) benchmark. This increases the DM’s “actual” welfare, defined as material welfare excluding the psychological cost term, when confirmation bias is moderate, while persuasion fails when the bias exceeds a threshold and the DM disengages. We then introduce processing-based confirmation bias, modeled as systematic misperception of signals. In isolation, it does not change equilibrium behavior or the DM’s “actual” welfare, but when combined with preference-based bias it strengthens the disciplining effect for the DM. A dynamic extension shows that future engagement concerns further increase the sender’s incentive to provide informative signals.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个贝叶斯说服博弈，其中决策者（DM）因信念相悖的信息而承担心理成本，并选择是否参与发送者的实验。我们将基于偏好的确认偏误建模为：决策者在接触与其先验信念相冲突的信号时所产生的心理不适。只要说服可行，发送者就必须承诺采用比 Kamenica–Gentzkow（2011）基准中信息量严格更大的实验。当确认偏误程度适中时，这会提高决策者的“实际”福利，即不包括心理成本项的物质福利；而当偏误超过某一阈值时，说服失败，决策者退出。随后，我们引入基于加工的确认偏误，将其建模为对信号的系统性误知。单独来看，它不会改变均衡行为或决策者的“实际”福利，但当它与基于偏好的偏误相结合时，会增强对决策者的约束效应。一个动态扩展表明，对未来参与的担忧会进一步增加发送者提供信息性信号的激励。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: How confirmation bias makes persuaders more honest
title_zh: 确认偏误如何使说服者更诚实

abstract: This paper argues that green hydrogen could be a driver of the technological transformation of a small open economy well integrated into the global energy market. Green hydrogen development is key to a sustainable transition of the economy. It can replace CO 2 -intensive technologies, e.g., in the transport sector, water cleaning facilities, and the steel industry. As the renewable energy potential is particularly high in Sub-Saharan Africa, it appears to be promising to install green hydrogen production facilities there, where they can contribute to “greening” the domestic economy while excess hydrogen production can be exported to generate revenue. In this paper we introduce a normative recursive growth model to investigate the case of Cameroon and demonstrate that the establishment of a green hydrogen sector can contribute to sustainable development where economic development goes hand in hand with environmentally friendly technological change. An essential precondition is education because the accumulation of human capital is necessary for implementing and distributing new, innovative technologies, as well as for building market institutions to lower the cost of capital and attract FDI to support the transformation of the Cameroonian economy.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，绿色氢能可以成为深度融入全球能源市场的小型开放经济体技术转型的驱动力。绿色氢能发展是经济可持续转型的关键。它可以替代二氧化碳密集型技术，例如在交通运输部门、水处理设施和钢铁工业中。由于撒哈拉以南非洲的可再生能源潜力尤其高，因此在那里建设绿色氢能生产设施似乎前景可观，这些设施既能促进国内经济“绿色化”，同时多余的氢能产量还可出口以创造收入。本文引入一个规范性递归增长模型来考察喀麦隆的案例，并证明建立绿色氢能部门能够促进可持续发展，使经济发展与环境友好型技术变革齐头并进。一个 essential 前提条件是教育，因为人力资本的积累对于实施和推广新的创新技术，以及建立降低资本成本、吸引外国直接投资以支持喀麦隆经济转型的市场制度而言，都是必要的。
title: Green hydrogen promotion in Cameroon: Implications for sustainable development
title_zh: 喀麦隆绿色氢能推广：对可持续发展的影响

abstract: We examine how religious observance affects educational performance by studying the years in which Ramadan overlapped with the national end-of-secondary-school exams in the Netherlands. Using administrative microdata and a difference-in-differences design, we find that students who are most likely to fast obtain lower exam scores and are more likely to fail to graduate. As expected given the structure of the Dutch exam system, the increase in failure risk is concentrated among students near the pass threshold. Effects are larger in more religiously segregated schools. For longer-term outcomes, we document a substantially higher likelihood of dropping out among students aged 18 and older, who are legally permitted to leave school and therefore at risk of doing so. Finally, analyses of exam timing suggest that modest adjustments—such as avoiding scheduling two exams on the same day during Ramadan—may help reduce the disadvantages experienced by observant students.
abstract_zh: 我们通过研究斋月与荷兰全国中学毕业考试重叠的年份，考察宗教遵守如何影响学业表现。利用行政微观数据和双重差分设计，我们发现最可能斋戒的学生考试成绩更低，且更可能未能毕业。正如荷兰考试体系结构所预期的那样，不及格风险的上升集中在接近及格线的学生中。在宗教隔离程度更高的学校，影响更大。就较长期结果而言，我们记录了18岁及以上学生辍学的可能性显著更高，因为该年龄段在法律上被允许离开学校，因而面临辍学风险。最后，对考试时间安排的分析表明，适度调整——例如避免在斋月期间将两场考试安排在同一天——可能有助于减少遵守斋戒的学生所经历的不利影响。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The fast and the studious? Ramadan observance and student performance
title_zh: 快速与勤奋？斋月遵守与学生表现

abstract: Many governments allocate access to high-rent natural resources through long-term concessions rather than competitive auctions. In Italy, coastal concessions for beach tourism have historically been renewed administratively, in tension with the EU Services (“Bolkestein”) Directive and recent European Court of Justice rulings. We provide an empirical assessment of this system, focusing on how concession fees relate to firms’ performance and local market conditions. We combine administrative data on maritime concessions with balance-sheet information from AIDA at the province and municipality levels, and exploit firm-level identifiers for the Campania region. First, we document strong spatial disparities: fees co-move with revenues but are weakly related to profits, while labor input is the main operational driver. Second, using a Pareto-based framework, we show that the nationally administered fee grid implies substantial under-pricing in high-inequality areas. Third, we construct firm-level valuation proxies in Campania using machine learning and use them to simulate exploratory auction scenarios. The results show that auction-based mechanisms can raise payments among allocated concessions, but aggregate fiscal gains depend critically on reserve prices, competition intensity, and fallback rules for non-allocated lots.
abstract_zh: 许多政府通过长期特许权而非竞争性拍卖来分配高租金自然资源的准入权。在意大利，海滩旅游的沿海特许权历来通过行政方式续期，这与欧盟服务业指令（“博尔克斯坦”指令）及近期欧洲法院裁决存在冲突。我们对该制度进行实证评估，重点关注特许权费用与企业绩效及地方市场条件之间的关系。我们将海事特许权的行政数据与AIDA在省级和市级层面的资产负债表信息相结合，并利用坎帕尼亚大区的企业级标识符。首先，我们记录了显著的空间差异：费用与收入同向变动，但与利润关联较弱，而劳动投入是主要的运营驱动因素。其次，我们运用基于帕累托分布的框架表明，全国统一管理的费用网格意味着在高不平等地区存在严重的定价不足。第三，我们利用机器学习在坎帕尼亚构建企业层面的估值代理变量，并用以模拟探索性拍卖情景。结果表明，基于拍卖的机制可以提高已分配特许权的支付额，但总体财政收益关键取决于保留价格、竞争强度以及未分配地块的兜底规则。
title: From coast to cost: Mispricing and reform scenarios in Italy’s coastal concession system
title_zh: 从海岸到成本：意大利沿海特许经营体系中的定价偏差与改革方案

abstract: Existing views on what venture capital finances and how its markets are structured are primarily shaped by the experience of the US and a few other high-income economies. This column presents evidence covering nearly 270,000 venture capital-backed startups in over 150 economies to provide a more complete picture. Venture capital markets differ across countries in size and also in kind. At lower levels of economic development, the composition tilts away from knowledge intangibles towards organisational intangibles. Yet differences in what venture capital finances tell only part of the story. Most of the cross-country gap in venture capital activity is associated with how many startups enter the funding pipeline rather than how much each raises.
abstract_zh: 关于风险资本融资对象及其市场结构的现有观点，主要受美国和少数其他高收入经济体的经验所塑造。本专栏呈现了涵盖150多个经济体中近27万家风险资本支持的初创企业的证据，以提供更完整的图景。风险资本市场在不同国家之间不仅规模不同，性质也不同。在较低经济发展水平上，其构成从知识无形资本转向组织无形资本。然而，风险资本融资对象的差异只说明了部分情况。风险资本活动中的大部分跨国差距，与有多少初创企业进入融资管道相关，而非与每家融资多少相关。
authors: Santiago Reyes Ortega, Kianna Freeman, Pablo Hernando-Kaminsky, Jeremias Huber, Paolo Mauro
title: Venture capital – a global perspective
title_zh: 风险投资——全球视角

abstract: Private debt is an important form of corporate financing in emerging markets, but its investor returns are not well understood. This paper uses loan-level cash flow data from the International Finance Corporation to provide the first systematic evidence on realized returns across 4,109 loans over more than 20 years, totaling about US$115 billion in 127 countries. Post–global financial crisis loans outperform both the JPMorgan Corporate Emerging Market Bond Index and U.S. Treasuries, with public market equivalents of 1.02 and 1.10, respectively, rising to 1.05 and 1.14 over the latest five years. Over 2002–24, the corresponding public market equivalents are 0.98 and 1.07, respectively, with global financial crisis–era vintages posting weaker performance relative to the JPMorgan Corporate Emerging Market Bond Index. Overall, returns are competitive with public markets. The paper also assesses financial performance more specifically within the most challenging markets: very low-income countries and fragile and conflict-affected states. Although default rates are higher in these markets, returns relative to public-market alternatives are statistically indistinguishable from those of the overall portfolio, suggesting that the International Finance Corporation priced default risk appropriately even in these markets.
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: Returns to Private Debt in Emerging and Developing Economies
title_zh: 新兴和发展中经济体的私人债务回报

abstract: We define the concept of customer overlap of product j with product k as the share of j’s customers who buy k. We argue that, in appropriate contexts, customer overlaps are an excellent proxy for diversion ratios, a useful and popular way to summarize competition between sellers of substitute products. Unlike diversion ratios, which are often challenging to estimate, customer overlaps are straightforwardly observed in many datasets. We show theoretically, and validate empirically, the close connection between customer overlaps and diversion ratios. We illustrate the potential use of customer overlap in contexts where estimation of diversion ratios could be prohibitive.
title: Customer Overlap and Diversion Ratios
title_zh: 客户重叠与转移比率

title_zh: 跨越国界的货币：从克罗伊斯到加密货币的全球货币——巴里·艾肯格林

abstract: We study how fertility decisions interact with labor supply and human capital accumulation of men and women. First, we use longitudinal Danish register data and tax reforms to show that increases in wages of women decrease fertility while increases in wages of men increase fertility. Second, we estimate a life-cycle model to quantify the importance of fertility adjustments for labor supply and long-run gender inequality. Wage elasticities of women are more than 10% lower if fertility cannot be adjusted. Finally, we show that the long-term consequence of human capital depreciation around childbirth is an important driver of the long-run gender wage gap in the model.
title: Fertility and Family Labor Supply
title_zh: 生育率与家庭劳动供给

abstract: Standard models of information frictions explain sluggishness in forecasts but struggle to account for excessive sensitivity. I argue that this gap reflects a narrow definition of information frictions: these models constrain the processing of new information while assuming agents can access and use previously acquired information without error. I propose a broader framework with two constraints: attention frictions introduce errors in how agents use new information, and memory frictions introduce errors in how they use previously acquired information. This unified model better matches observed forecast biases and jointly identifies attention and memory frictions using survey forecasts.
title: Macroeconomic Expectations and Cognitive Noise
title_zh: 宏观经济预期与认知噪声

abstract: This paper examines the unequal impact of unsafe public spaces on women’s human capital attainment through their choice of college. Combining survey data from students attending the University of Delhi, a mapping of actual and potential travel routes to all colleges in students’ admission choice set, and mobile-application safety data from Delhi, I find that, relative to men with comparable choice sets, women choose colleges that are 20 percent lower in the college-quality distribution because of travel-safety concerns. These large effects have implications for other economic decisions, such as women’s participation in the labor force.
title: Safety First: Perceived Risk of Street Harassment and Educational Choices of Women
title_zh: 安全第一：感知到的街头骚扰风险与女性教育选择
